shared_costs.allocation_rule: Dedicated branch repair-author response tokens are attributed to their branch. All other repair root/orchestration, verification and auditing response usage is kept in one shared pool. Do not split 50/50 and do not charge the whole pool to each branch.
shared_costs.time_note: Children continued working after first parent completion and before the second parent turn; the gap between parent turns is not necessarily idle experiment time. Wall phase includes all observed repairs and joint validation/reporting, not just author compute.
shared_costs.all_repair_arithmetic: all_observed_repair_tokens = graphify later_dedicated_repair_author + knowledge later_dedicated_repair_author + unallocated_support_only_tokens. The shared support pool excludes both dedicated repair authors.

takeaways.title: 26.4% less delivered code + data
takeaways.text: Memory has no mandatory size ratio. It finishes with595,793 source tokens and38,608 resource tokens under the common policy.

takeaways.title: Documentation is a major trade-off
takeaways.text: Dual preserves the original documentation with a small size reduction. The five reconstruction runs remove most inline documentation.

takeaways.title: Repair dominates the story
takeaways.text: Initial small candidates were not final accepted products. Regressions, interrupted work and later repair remain visible in the trajectory and usage ledgers.

interpretation.title: Memory: broad evidence, larger footprint
interpretation.text: Choose it for its recorded stopping rule and broad final acceptance evidence. Its delivered source is larger than the independent rewrites, but it retains much more type information. Restore API/user documentation before claiming readability as a clear win.

interpretation.title: Dual: preservation with modest compression
interpretation.text: It retains almost all source, documentation and annotation structure, with strong bounded runtime evidence. Its1.64% source-token reduction is far from the intended50% target; judge it as a conservative refactor.

interpretation.title: Effort: compact, with a task-driven repair
interpretation.text: Its source-plus-resource total is the smallest here. Its seven-round process also shows why passing a core suite is insufficient: a modification task exposed a remaining SemSeg bug. Readability and task cost are not established wins.

interpretation.title: Avoid a single winner on cost
interpretation.text: Graphify and Knowledge include broader orchestration ledgers and later shared repair. Efficient, Dual and Effort still have missing usage. Different model settings, coverage and endpoints prevent a fair ranking of runtime, tokens or algorithm quality.

performance_note: Memory and Dual each have10 GPU workloads ×4 paired rounds against their own original baseline. Different run dates/allocations mean these are not a controlled six-way speed comparison.

Memory:124 output/gradient observations stayed within predeclared tolerance;16 checkpoint loads checked130 tensors. Deform-convolution peak PyTorch allocator usage increased292,352 bytes (about286 KiB,1.61%); the other9 workload peaks matched. Some individual timing rounds were slower.
Dual also has paired performance, two-GPU TorchScript,25-step NCCL and cross-implementation resume evidence (234 array comparisons). Neither suite proves general speedup or training convergence.

Knowledge and Graphify have fixed-state inference and short training, BF16/distributed probes and a100-image COCO sample. The two candidates have matching recorded bbox AP, mask AP and detection counts on that sample, but both have nonzero metric deltas versus original; original binding is indirect. This is not full COCO accuracy equivalence.
task_note: Memory disabled task assessment and stopped pure-size optimization after acceptance. No downstream task-efficiency result is available.

Effort: four cognitive task types; final12/12 development results correct,3/4 strict cost gates passed, overall inconclusive. Task evaluation alone accounts for at least50.68M tokens including earlier protocol work.

Efficient: one modify task, three repeats; median token use rose232,457 →263,512 (+13.36%), with overlapping ranges. Dual:402,117 →336,229 median tokens and302.8 →291.0 seconds, also overlapping ranges. Both verdicts are inconclusive; held-out runs were not performed.
